The fountain, adorned with bronze sculptures and flowing water, serves as the centrepiece of the square. In the background, the Basilica del Mare with its iconic dome and the historic Valencia Cathedral with its intricate Gothic architecture add depth and grandeur to the scene. The combination of classical artwork, architectural beauty, and lively atmosphere creates a quintessential view of Valencia's rich cultural heritage.
